d: Before FIFTY SHADES OF GREY, there was this sexy and daring comedy starring James Spader and Maggie Gyllenhaal about a kinky affair between a lawyer and his secretary.
A man (Andrew Garfield) struggles to get back his family home that they were evicted from by working for the greedy real estate broker (Michael Shannon) who's the source of his frustration.

What if the woman you loved disappeared without a word? How far would you go to find her again? Josh Hartnett, Diane Kruger, Rose Byrne and Matthew Lillard star in this intense neo-noir where love turns to obsession and no one is who they seem.

In this delightfully hilarious Jane Austen adaptation, Lady Susan Vernon (Kate Beckinsale) takes up temporary residence at her in-laws' estate and, while there, is determined to be a matchmaker for her daughter Frederica - and herself too, naturally.
Max Perkins discovered Ernest Hemingway and F. Scott Fitzgerald. But he never met anyone like Thomas Wolfe.
A drama set in the early 1960s and centered on a young couple on their honeymoon.
This ambitious frontier epic features a lawman (Kris Kristofferson) and a hitman (Christopher Walken) who fight in a tragic class war between ranchers and starving immigrants.
John Malkovich, Gary Sinise and Sherilyn Fenn shine in this contemporary remake of the beloved classic about a nomadic farm worker who looks after his dimwitted, gentle-giant friend.

After encountering and eventually being accepted by a Native American tribe, Dunbar's loyalties are put to the test when the army threatens his new home, forcing him to choose between white America or the natives he now calls his people.
